All 3 tests pass now (previously the even-length test failed with `3 != 2.5`). The fix: `median()` in src/stats.py:19-22 wasn't averaging the two middle elements for even-length lists — it just returned `ordered[mid]`. Now it correctly returns `(ordered[mid-1] + ordered[mid]) / 2` when the length is even.
